blocks.text: A Tampa CPA Provides Help if You Owe Back Taxes

There are a number of reasons why an individual or company might owe back taxes. Math errors are one common cause of underpaid taxes, especially if the forms were not prepared by a professional certified public accountant. Believe it or not, the IRS is remarkably flexible when it comes to working with taxpayers who might have underpaid their taxes for whatever reason. That said, no one wants to experience the hassle of a confrontation with the IRS, no matter how accommodating the agents might be.

A [Tampa CPA](http://reliancecpa.com) from Reliance Consulting, LLC, can help make sure that your taxes are in order before, thereby reducing or even eliminating the potential for error. We also know that an ounce of accounting prevention – through the measured use of experienced tax planning – is worth a pound of the “cure” of negotiating with the IRS. Since opening our doors in 1984, Reliance has helped thousands of Florida residents and businesses with tax planning and preparation, so we are well-positioned to aid anyone who finds him- or herself owing back taxes.
